name: Early Christian Church

citations.locator: Vol. 1, ch. IV, § 24, The Miracle of Pentecost and the Birthday of the Christian Church
citations.excerpt: § 24. The Miracle of Pentecost and the Birthday of the Christian Church. a.d. 30.
The ascension of Christ to heaven was followed ten days afterwards by the descent of the Holy Spirit upon earth and the birth of the Christian Church.

facts.value: The first Christian community, which the apostles' preaching in Jerusalem gathered by baptism into a society of disciples.

citations.locator: Church, section The Church after the Ascension
citations.excerpt: St. Peter, in his first sermon , delivered on the day of Pentecost, declares that Jesus of Nazareth is the Messianic king ( Acts 2:36 ). The means of salvation which he indicates is baptism ; and by baptism his converts are aggregated to the society of disciples ( Acts 2:41 ).

research_notes: Exact year depends on the crucifixion date. Schaff gives AD 30.
